title: Facebook lets users describe the feed they want
friendlyTitle: You can tell Facebook what you want to see
summary: Meta is rolling out “Your algorithm” on Facebook, allowing people to add and manage topics for Feed and Reels in natural language. New feedback prompts can also ask why a person marked a post as interesting or uninteresting, with recommendations updating during the session.
friendlySummary: Facebook is adding a tool where you can describe topics you want more or less of. Its recommendations can then change straight away.
whyItMatters: Recommendation systems normally infer preferences from behaviour; this gives users a more direct input. It may make a feed more useful, but people should still expect engagement history and other signals to influence what appears.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This gives you more control over your feed. It does not mean Facebook stops using your past activity to choose posts.
